policy.unstable_flags: Cargo -Z and other nightly-only flags are not exposed in the stable Sifr package surface.

commands.name: run
commands.delegates_to: cargo run for package app targets; Sifr-owned explicit .sifr and script pre-resolution stay outside Cargo.
intentional_exclusions: Feature selection and Cargo common display/config flags pending full delegated-command passthrough.

commands.name: check
commands.delegates_to: cargo check when no explicit .sifr file is selected.
intentional_exclusions: Workspace/package/target/feature selector passthrough is represented in the session model and completed by workspace-selection ruless.

commands.name: build
commands.delegates_to: cargo build for package build plans after package-aware compiler integration.
intentional_exclusions: Existing explicit-file build surface is preserved until package build integration lands.

commands.name: test
commands.delegates_to: cargo test for package test plans after package-aware compiler integration.
intentional_exclusions: Existing directory test runner remains active while package test lowering is staged.

commands.name: init
intentional_exclusions: Cargo template flags are excluded because Sifr owns package layout generation.

commands.name: fetch
intentional_exclusions: --target and --manifest-path passthrough are deferred until workspace/package selection is complete.

commands.name: add
commands.delegates_to: cargo add command plan through Sifr-facing dependency mutation.
intentional_exclusions: Full dependency mutation CLI lands after session command integration.

commands.name: remove
commands.delegates_to: cargo remove command plan through Sifr-facing dependency mutation.
intentional_exclusions: Full dependency mutation CLI lands after session command integration.

commands.name: update
commands.delegates_to: cargo update command plan through Sifr-facing dependency mutation.
intentional_exclusions: Full update CLI lands after session command integration.

commands.name: tree
intentional_exclusions: Tree-specific flags are forwarded as Cargo-compatible trailing args by the tree command rules.

commands.name: vendor
intentional_exclusions: Public CLI belongs to the packaging/publishing rules.

commands.name: package
commands.delegates_to: cargo package after Sifr archive preflight.
intentional_exclusions: Public CLI belongs to the packaging/publishing rules; no Sifr --dry-run alias is introduced.

commands.name: publish
commands.delegates_to: cargo publish after Sifr publish preflight.
intentional_exclusions: Public CLI belongs to the packaging/publishing rules.
